cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Start the Hard Part
cards.instruction: Get someone else to explain, announce, or begin the emotionally difficult part.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Phone Mum about selling the house. Start with the upkeep, please, not property prices. You have to prepare her properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She asked to speak to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And she will. First say the repairs are too much, then the word 'selling'. Don't offer a date; I'll handle the details.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm putting her on speaker. I'm not taking all the shouting while you hide.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. Keep it on speaker. But don't say 'we've something to tell you'; say 'selling the house'. I'll come in once she's answered that.

reason: Make A direct the precise difficult opening while accepting B's speakerphone condition; remove generic expertise announcements.
